title: Kenworth T659 Custom Built Powder Coated FUPS Compliant Road Train Aluminium Bullbar #73
description: Kenworth T659 high tensile powder coated aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Heavy Duty pressed high tensile aluminium channel plus Cow Catcher with 3 small uprights. Standard 88mm diameter pipe but optional 76mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. One piece pipes through drilled heavy duty posts. Reversible Road Train/Over Size signs with heavy duty storage bag supplied. Driving light and light bar mounts fitted to suit customer requirements. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
